challenge.better_approach: Looked: a hook or the ground loop committing dirty records (rejected: it commits other tickets' records, the defect d3b8cdf81a41 fixed in close.sh); a git call inside projector.append_entry (rejected: scratch proofs call it). A helper at the crossing's own door is smallest.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every uncommitted crossing came through a verb (sail cross/verdict) rather than a close that failed midway: measured only for the three FIXME and one SUPERSEDED crossings I know; the 7cae18f7f9c2 BUILDME crossing's path is unread.
challenge.prior_art: In-house: close.sh commit_all and d3b8cdf81a41 (commit only own ticket's records), 11cd253f10bc/12443bcc113f (PROVEME clean-tree gate), ticket ee9637b02525's first plan (sail.py alone). Grepped tickets for a crossing-records commit at the door: none owns it.
challenge.real_collision: Possible with 12443bcc113f (another ticket's records do not refuse a crossing): committing own records at the verb is consistent with it; no Law contradicted. Distinction recorded.

answers.falsifier: A proof drives a scratch crossing and finds: after Ticket.failed sends a ticket to FIXME (the chart gate's _fail path, actor codemother), the component's history.json and state.json are committed and git status of those two paths is clean
answers.from_idea: none, because it is a measured gap: 2026-11-19 akiendell: five crossings sat uncommitted in the house tree (tester seq 408, codemother seq 172, verdict seq 32, chart_gate seq 9 and 10), landed by hand on akiendell-1eee-fixme-record (0065e73b6); see cairn/machines/ticket/intention+why.json
answers.how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: ticket.py gains commit_crossing_records(history_path, state_path, why), which stages and commits only those two files; Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed call it after their crossing lands; it is named in cairn/machines/ticket/intention+why.json public_interface for sail.py (ee9637b02525) and clearance.py (sibling ticket) to call. It stays out of projector.append_entry, which scratch proofs call.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (permanent in records of truth: a crossing that exists on one disk is not permanent); Law 4 (enforced by physics, not by a hand remembering sail step 10); Law 5 (the repo is itself the state of the machine).
answers.what: Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed each end by committing the crossed component's history.json and state.json, path-limited, through one helper the ticket machine publishes in its public_interface, so a gate's crossing never sits as uncommitted dirt on one disk.
